Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 4 (test build)

Test build adding the daily owner check, enrollment codes, delegation statements and stricter credential and recovery rules.

Status

Status
Deprecated (move-only)
Published
2026-10-07
End date
Not set

Replaced by a newer release. It still unlocks and lets you move to the newer release, nothing more.

Changes

  • The daily owner check: a vault whose owner has not confirmed with PIN and password for 24 hours is held, and its agents pause, until the owner does (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.13.0).
  • Enrollment codes, app keys and account status (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.15.0).
  • Delegation and status statements in the LEASH format (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.12.0).
  • A credential can no longer be deleted on its own, and recovery needs the credential backup to be on (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.15.2 and 0.16.0).
  • A transferred app learns its account from the pairing, and errors say how long to wait before retrying (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.17.0).
  • Built from vettid-vault commit f5cf127 (tag release/staging/4) and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-07 with a matching PCR0.

Security

No security fix
